svg.title: Figure 2 — Laboratory per-point percentage deviation — synthetic sample — not a measurement
svg.desc: synthetic sample — not a measurement. Eighteen panels follow run order from left to right and then down. Each retains the eight sensor percentage-deviation traces by point index, with point 0 excluded; no trend across runs is drawn.
